front.title: Substrate-Observation as an Alternative to Envelope Coordination for Concurrent Sessions

abstract.t: This memo describes a coordination-protocol anti-pattern observed in cross-tool agentic systems and a substrate-observation alternative that does not require negotiating a wire format between heterogeneous concurrent sessions of an identity-bound principal. The memo is Informational and proposes no protocol element for standardisation. It sets out what should not be standardised for this problem, and why, and identifies the existing substrate mechanisms that serve in its place. Companion memos describe the identity primitives this memo presumes.
